review_method.visual_basis: High-level discovery-index labels plus a reusable profile mapping; no record-level manual asset review is attached.

review_method.boundary: This candidate is a routing aid for manual review. It cannot establish asset-specific visual mechanics, animation behaviour, factual claims, or a high-confidence creative mechanism.

inspection_limitations: No manual asset-specific visual review is attached to this generated candidate.

source_context.creator: Not reliably extracted from the supplied workbook; inspect post or visible asset before attribution.
caption_argument_segments: Most people don’t struggle with AI… They struggle with the jargon.
So I broke down 40 AI terms into something your brain actually understands.
A few months ago, I realised something weird.
People weren’t scared of AI. They were confused by words like “LLM”, “tokens”, “fine-tuning”.
observed_performance_context: Included in Tiger’s intentionally curated Top-100 reference set.
unknowns: Original post-level analytics unless separately captured.
Independent validation of factual or numerical claims within the source post.

template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_visual_mechanism: AI terms explained as a journey path
template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_transferable_atom: Long vocabulary list gains rhythm from one continuous path
template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_cognitive_job: Give readers a simple classification system that helps them identify what they are looking at.
template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_caption_job: Clarify scope, edge cases and the selection criterion that the visual cannot fully contain.
candidate_use_when: The domain has a stable, useful set of categories.
A reader can identify an option using visible criteria.
candidate_do_not_use_when: Categories are arbitrary, disputed or need extensive caveats.
A process map is needed instead of a classification.
The list is presented as complete without a scope boundary.
template_assisted_hypotheses.candidate_reverse_build_specification: When a chosen opportunity needs classification rather than progression, create repeated category units with one clear differentiator and an explicit scope. Make it easy for a reader to place an example without pretending all edge cases disappear.
template_assisted_hypotheses.topic_selection_boundary: This template does not select a future topic, audience, factual claim or post angle.
template_assisted_hypotheses.required_next_step: Inspect the local asset and write record-specific evidence before promoting any candidate field into a manual forensic record or Creative Genome retrieval.

generation.method: discovery-index label plus reusable profile mapping
